questions.stem: What did Jhumpa say when she tasted the lemon juice?
questions.solution: The correct answer is 'Sour lemon' because lemon juice is naturally acidic and has a sour taste. 'Sweet sugar' describes a sweet taste, which does not match lemon juice. 'Bitter karela' refers to a bitter taste, which is not characteristic of lemon juice. 'Salty salt' describes a salty taste, which is also not associated with lemon juice.

questions.stem: If a child does not get enough food for a long time, what health problems might they face?
choices: They will have a big appetite
They will be weak and sickly
questions.solution: When a child does not get enough food for a long time, their body lacks the necessary nutrients and energy to function properly, leading to weakness and illness. The other options suggest positive physical conditions, which would not occur due to a lack of food.

hi.stem: अगर एक बच्चे को लंबे समय तक पर्याप्त भोजन नहीं मिलता है, तो उसे कौन सी स्वास्थ्य समस्याएं हो सकती हैं?
hi.solution: जब एक बच्चे को लंबे समय तक पर्याप्त भोजन नहीं मिलता है, तो उसके शरीर के पास उचित पोषक तत्व और ऊर्जा नहीं होती है जो उसके शरीर के कार्य करने के लिए आवश्यक है, जिसके कारण कमजोरी और बीमारी हो सकती है। अन्य विकल्प धनात्मक शारीरिक स्थिति को दर्शाते हैं, जो भोजन के अभाव में होने वाली नहीं है।
hi.critique: The Hindi translation is accurate, maintains the original meaning, and uses appropriate terminology. The correct answer remains option (4) and the distractors are still incorrect.

mr.stem: जर एक मुलाला लांब काळ खूप पुरेसे खाण्याची गरज नसेल, तर त्याला कोणते आरोग्य समस्या उद्भवू शकतात?
